seo_title: Dating App Auto Like & Profile Visits | Auto Like Assistant
seo_desc: Free Chrome extension that automates likes on Tinder, Badoo and OkCupid and profile visits on Pairs. Set a delay and a limit, press Start, let it run.
hero_pain:
Opening profile after profile and tapping Like every day —
isn't it a chore?
hero_h1:
That busywork?
You can automate it.
hero_sub:
A Chrome extension that automates likes and profile visits on dating apps.
Press Start and leave it running — it reaches 100+ profiles an hour.
video_h2: See Auto Like Assistant in action
why_h2: Why do likes and visits matter so much?
why_p1:
To get a match, the other person first has to know you exist.
The easiest way to show up is a like — or, on Japanese apps like Pairs, a profile visit that leaves a “footprint”.
why_p2:
Doing it by hand means opening and tapping one profile at a time.
The more people you reach, the more people see you.
why_p3: In short — people reached = chances to meet.
compare_h2: How many profiles can you get through in an hour by hand?
compare_desc: Open a profile, go back, scroll, tap again — one at a time. You don't have to anymore.
demo_h2: Press Start, then let it run
demo_desc: It works right on the real Tinder website, sending a regular like to each profile shown, one at a time. On Japanese apps such as Pairs, it opens each profile to leave a visit.
demo_alt: Auto Like Assistant running on the real Tinder website, with its control panel showing the delay and limit settings (photos blurred for privacy)
demo_caption: Actual Tinder screen with an example of the control panel. Members' photos are blurred for privacy.
benefits_h2: What changes when you use it
benefits_desc: With Auto Like Assistant, the way you use dating apps changes completely.
b1_p: By hand, 20–30 profiles an hour is the limit. With Auto Like Assistant, 100+ — and you can leave it running.
b2_p: When people notice your like or visit, they come to look at your profile. That's how matches start.
b3_p: Spend the time you used to tap away on improving your bio and photos instead.
features_desc: Every feature is free. No in-app purchases.
f1_p: Keeps going until your limit. On Tinder, Badoo and OkCupid it likes card after card; on Japanese apps it reloads the search page every set number of people to load new profiles.
f2_p: Set a minimum and maximum delay in seconds; each profile gets a random wait within that range, for a natural pace.
f3_p: Set a maximum total; it stops automatically when it gets there, so you never overdo it.
f4_p: Sends regular likes automatically on Tinder, Badoo, OkCupid and Match. On Tokyo Calendar Date it can also like the profiles it visits.
f5_p: Profiles it has handled are remembered so the same person is not repeated (depending on the app and run state).
f6_p: Settings and visit history are saved in your browser. The extension does not send them to any external server.
howto_desc: No complicated setup. Presets are built in, so it works right after you install it.
step1_p: Just add it from the Chrome Web Store. No account or sign-in needed.
step2_p: Open a supported app's website in Chrome and the control panel appears in the bottom-right corner.
step3_h3: Press Start and let it run
step3_p: That's it — it keeps going on its own. Keep the browser window in the foreground while it runs.
safety_desc: Here is what we do so you can use it with peace of mind.
s1_p: No personal information is collected. All data is stored locally in your browser.
s2_p: No data is sent to external servers. Uninstalling removes all of it.
s3_p: The delay is picked at random within your range, so it never clicks at a fixed, mechanical interval.
s4_p: A total limit prevents unusually heavy activity and keeps the risk as low as possible.
warn_p: This may violate each dating app's terms of service. Account suspension is a real possibility, so please decide for yourself whether to use it. This is an unofficial tool, not affiliated with any of the apps. Use it at your own risk.
faq1_a: Yes, completely free. There are no paid features, and it will stay free.
faq2_a: It sends regular likes automatically on Tinder, Badoo, OkCupid and Match, and visits profiles on the Japanese apps Pairs, with and Tokyo Calendar Date. Tokyo Calendar Date needs Chrome's mobile view, and Match supports the Japanese search page.
faq3_a: You can adjust the delay and the limit, but it may violate the apps' terms, so the risk is not zero. Verification prompts, usage limits and automation blocks are not bypassed. Use it at your own risk.
faq4_a: Likes and visits go through the app's normal buttons and pages, so they look the same as ones you make by hand.
faq5_q: Does it work on my phone?
faq5_a: It's a Chrome extension, so you need Google Chrome on a computer. It doesn't work in Chrome on phones.
faq6_a: No. All data is stored locally in your browser, nothing is sent to external servers, and uninstalling removes it completely.
cta_h2:
Before you wait for likes,
let people know you're there.
sum1: Works with 7 dating apps, including Tinder, Badoo and OkCupid
sum3: Installs in 30 seconds, then just let it run
cta_note: Add it straight from the Chrome Web Store
